name: Mento Euro
oneLiner: EURm is Mento's oracle-priced euro stablecoin on Celo, mint and redeem through the Mento reserve backed by a diversified crypto and stablecoin basket.
collateral: Mento Reserve holding sUSDS, AUSD, CELO, USDC, EURC, USDT, axlEUROC, and stETH; overcollateralized with a stable-asset backing mandate.
pegMechanism: Mento V3 reserve-backed FX model: EURm is minted and redeemed against the shared Mento Reserve through Fixed-Price Market Maker (FPMM) pools that quote a Chainlink EUR oracle rate rather than deriving price from pool reserves, with on-chain trading limits and circuit breakers halting trade when the oracle is stale or off-peg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes EURm pricing through Chainlink-backed SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-peg feeds before FPMM swaps use them.

branchApplicability.rationale: Mento documents EURm as a reserve-backed FPMM asset whose swaps use an OracleAdapter rate and whose reserve flows are governed by trading limits and circuit breakers. The reviewed EURm product does not expose borrower-owned collateral debt positions or token-level liquidation branches; the oracle governs pool pricing and trading validity instead.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Explicit true: a live authorized burner (the Mento Broker) can directly burn an arbitrary holder balance, and the owner Safe can authorize further burners or operators that move holder balances without allowance. This direct freeze/blacklist-equivalent capability is distinct from the transfer-review lane and does not suppress the upstream reserve-basket exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Write-time re-read at Celo block 73546760 (2026-07-30): the EURm proxy 0xd8763cba276a3738e6de85b4b3bf5fded6d6ca73 resolves to the Blockscout-verified StableTokenV3 implementation 0x815795c30d0758a297b08cd4e0643620c974c318 and owner() returned the Mento Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 (Safe API at write time: threshold 4, 6 owners). isBurner(0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD) returned true: the Mento Broker is a live burner and can call burn(address account, uint256 value) against an arbitrary holder balance without allowance. The verified source also exposes owner-gated setBurner(address,bool) and setOperator(address,bool); an enabled operator can sendToPool(sender,pool,amount) from an arbitrary holder. The observed burner uses constrained protocol paths, but the owner Safe can authorize another burner or operator. This establishes a current direct individual-holder intervention capability even though the ABI has no named blacklist, freeze, or pause function. Same implementation and verdict as the reviewed chfm-mento precedent.

mintAuthority.summary: EURm minting on Celo routes through the Mento Broker contract (confirmed isMinter), while token ownership resolves to a 4/6 Mento Safe; identical structure to verified GBPm.

controls.capDescription: Mento Broker minting is rate-limited by Mento exchange limits and circuit breakers on the EURm FPMM pool.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291541, isMinter(0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD) returned true. Minting is rate-limited by Mento exchange limits and circuit breakers on the FPMM pool.

controls.label: Mento EURm token owner Safe
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291541, owner() returned 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458. Safe API returned threshold 4, 6 owners (down from 7 recorded previously — signer was rotated out), no modules, zero guard. Follow-up 2026-07-20: as EURm token owner this Safe administers the minter set (it can authorize or replace the Broker and its exchange limits), so the Broker's mint cap is raiseable by this control.

review.evidence: Celo block 69291541: owner() = 4/6 Safe (threshold 4, 6 owners, no modules); isMinter(Broker 0x777A...) = true. Both mint-capable surfaces confirmed. Safe lost one signer since prior review (7→6); threshold unchanged at 4. Identical pattern to verified gbpm-mento.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURm has native Celo and Monad deployments connected through Mento's Wormhole NTT configuration. The residual Ethereum and Polygon supply is legacy Optics-bridged cEUR (token owner is the Optics BridgeRouter, verified on-chain), and the Solana supply is legacy Allbridge cEUR (mint authority verified). Pinned totalSupply reads on 2026-07-21 establish 2,073,193.841739276070272578 unique EURm/cEUR claims: 1,688,715.972819276070272578 in the Celo canonical supply, including the backing of legacy lock-mint representations, plus 384,477.868920000000000000 on the Monad NTT burn-mint deployment. Monad therefore carries 18.54519636% of unique claims, so the chain:monad common-mode exposure is attributed and remains above the 10% materiality threshold.
